test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kosi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kosi is known as the **'Sorrow of Bihar'.**
 
• Kosi River:
 
 
• These include the Tamur Koshi originating from the Kanchenjunga area in the east, the Arun River from Tibet, and Sun Koshi from the Gosainthan area farther west. The Sun Koshi's tributaries from east to west are Dudh Koshi, Bhote Koshi, Tamba Koshi, and Indravati Koshi. 
 
• The sources of seven streams of the Kosi are located in snow-covered areas which also receive heavy rainfall.
 
 
• Consequently, a huge volume of water flows with tremendous speed.
 
 
 
• They unite at Triveni north of the Mahabharata Range to form the Kosi.
 
• The river enters the Tarai of Nepal after cutting a narrow gorge in the Mahabharata Range.
 
• The river channel is braided and it shifts its course frequently.
 
• This has resulted in frequent devastating floods and has converted large tracts of cultivable land into the wasteland in Bihar.
 
 
• **Hence, the Kosi River is often referred to as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'.**​
 
 
 
 

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/917ccc7ffa6d7421b062ae08dddf8b091f383585bd136bb1b1421dc5ede8de80.png] **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The Koshi is 720 km (450 mi) long and drains an area of about 74,500 km2 (28,800 sq mi) in Tibet, Nepal, and Bihar.
 
• A review of 28 historical maps from 1760 to 1960 found that there was a slight eastward change in river course over a long period and that the shift was random and oscillatory in nature.
 
• During a flood, the average water flow (discharge) increases up to 18 times the average.
 
• As the annual floods affect about 21,000 km2 (8,100 sq mi) of fertile agricultural lands thereby disturbing the rural economy. Hence, the Kosi River is often referred to as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'.
 
• The Kosi river **joins the Ganges at Kursela in the Katihar** district of Bihar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **sorrow of Bengal **is the **Damodar River.**
 
• The **sorrow of Odisha** is the **Mahanadi river.**
 
• The **sorrow of Assam** is the **Brahmaputra river.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

 
• **Dagmara Hydro Energy Project**

 
 
• It will be built **on the Kosi river.**
 
• An MoU has been signed between NHPC Limited and Bihar State Hydroelectric Power Corporation Limited (BSHPC) for the implementation of the **130.1 Megawatt (MW)** Dagmara HE Project in** Supaul, Bihar.**
 
 
 
• **Kosi Rail Mahasety (Mega Bridge)**
 
 
• ​Inaugurated by - PM Narendra Modi
 
• Length - 1.9 km
 
• Connecting - Mithila and Kosi region
 
• It reduces the rail distance between Nirmali and Saraigarh from the present 298 Km to 22 Km.
 
 

ee:T
